1.name: Basal cell carcinoma
1.description: Basal cell carcinoma: pearly translucent papule with arborizing vessels, leaf-like areas, blue-grey ovoid nests, and shiny white structures â€” locally invasive skin malignancy.

2.name: Benign keratosis
2.description: Benign keratosis: stuck-on seborrheic keratosis with cerebriform surface, milia-like cysts, comedo-like openings, well-demarcated borders, and waxy brown-to-black pigmentation.

3.name: Dermatofibroma
3.description: Dermatofibroma: central white scar-like patch surrounded by delicate peripheral pigment network â€” firm benign dermal papule with positive dimple sign.

4.name: Melanoma
4.description: Melanoma: asymmetric lesion with atypical pigment network, blue-white veil, regression structures, irregular streaks, and multiple colours â€” malignant melanocytic tumour meeting ABCDE criteria.

5.name: Melanocytic nevi
5.description: Melanocytic nevi: benign symmetric mole with regular pigment network, uniform brown-to-black colour, smooth borders, and homogeneous or globular pattern.

6.name: Vascular lesions
6.description: Vascular lesion: cherry angioma or pyogenic granuloma with well-defined red to purple lacunae, reddish homogeneous area, sharp borders, and no pigment network.
